skill.displayName: feishu-card-sender-beautify 飞书推送展示卡片脚本
skill.summary: 发送飞书 Interactive Card 格式消息，用于美化富文本卡片推送和优化通知。 触发条件：(1) 用户要求发送卡片消息 (2) 定时任务推送 (3) 格式化通知需求

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of feishu-card-sender-beautify

- Enables sending visually enhanced Feishu Interactive Card messages.
- Supports triggers: user requests, scheduled tasks, and formatted notifications.
- Provides card structure examples and color template options.
- Includes documentation links for card templates and API reference.
- Details correct usage for group and user IDs.
